data.text:
Sept 21 rally is NOT about endorsing any political party. Misinformation is being spread to discourage people from showing up. This is a call to stand together against corruption—regardless of political affiliation. Corrupt officials, all sides, must be held accountable.

📌 September 21 Anti-Corruption Rallies (Luneta & EDSA)

Why it matters:
✔️The rallies target massive corruption in flood control projects (₱1.9T spent over 15 years, half allegedly lost).

✔️Reminder that corruption is not tied to party colors—“politicians and contractors… worship the color of money.”

✔️Call for unity across faith, politics, and social classes to reclaim the nation from corruption.

Where & When:
📍Luneta / Rizal Park, Manila
Rally: “Baha sa Luneta: Aksyon na Laban sa Korapsyon” 
Time: 9:00 AM
Organized by: University students, activist groups, environmental coalitions.

📍People Power Monument, EDSA
Rally: “Trillion Peso March”
Time: 2:00 PM
Organized by: Catholic & Protestant leaders (CLCNT), 1Sambayan, civil society orgs, labor & women’s groups.
Attendees encouraged to wear white shirts (symbol of unity & hope).

Dalawang magkahiwalay na lugar ang inoperate ng MMDA Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) ngayong araw para umasiste at magmando ng trapiko para sa mas maayos na daloy nito.

Nagsagawa ng traffic direction control at umasiste ang STAG sa mga motorista't school buses sa La Salle Greenhills habang nagkasa naman ng operasyon kontra illegally parked vehicles sa Mabuhay Lane Route 1 (mula Timog hanggang Makati-Mandaluyong Bridge).

54 sasakyan ang nahuli.

Gamit ng grupo ang mga body-worn camera para sa mas mahigpit na pagpapatupad ng batas trapiko. Dahil dito, bawas o minimal ang interaksyon sa pagitan ng enforcer at motorista.

#mmda #mmdaatyourservice
